title: 여성의 경제활동 촉진과 경력단절 예방법 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 성평등가족부 (경제활동촉진과), 02-2100-6622
rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Economic Activity Promotion Division ), 02-2100-6622

rows.source_ko: 고용노동부 (고용문화개선정책과), 044-202-7506
rows.text_en: Ministry of Employment and Labor ( Employment Culture Improvement Policy Division ), 044-202-7506

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「여성의 경제활동 촉진과 경력단절 예방법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Promotion of Economic Activities of Women and Prevention of Career Interruption and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(여성 경력설계 및 개발 상담 등의 실시기관) 법 제12조에서 “여성인력개발기관 등 성평등가족부와 고용노동부의 공동부령(이하 "공동부령"이라 한다)으로 정하는 기관”이란 다음 각 호의 기관을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Implementing Agencies for Women’s Career Planning and Development Counseling, etc.) In Article 12 of the Act , the term “women’s workforce development agencies, etc., prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family and the Ministry of Employment and Labor (hereinafter referred to as the “Joint Ministerial Ordinance”)” refers to the agencies listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「양성평등기본법」 제47조에 따른 여성인력개발센터
rows.text_en: 1. Women's Human Resources Development Center pursuant to Article 47 of the Framework Act on Gender Equality

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제17조제1항 및 같은 법 시행령(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제5조에 따라 지정된 여성경제활동지원센터(이하 “지역지원센터”라 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Women’s Economic Activity Support Centers designated pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Article 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) (hereinafter referred to as “Regional Support Centers”)

rows.source_ko: 3. 「고등교육법」 제2조에 따른 학교
rows.text_en: 3. Schools pursuant to Article 2 of the Higher Education Act

rows.source_ko: 제3조(경력단절 예방 사업 등의 실시기관) 법 제15조제2항에서 “여성인력개발기관 등 공동부령으로 정하는 기관”이란 제2조 각 호의 기관을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Implementing agencies for career interruption prevention projects, etc.) In Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “agencies designated by joint ministerial decree, such as women’s workforce development agencies” refers to the agencies listed in each subparagraph of Article 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제4조(중앙여성경제활동지원센터의 지정 신청 등) ① 영 제4조제2항에 따른 중앙여성경제활동지원센터 지정신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Designation of Central Women’s Economic Activity Support Center, etc.) ① The application form for designation of the Central Women’s Economic Activity Support Center pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제4조제2항에 따라 중앙여성경제활동지원센터(이하 “중앙지원센터”라 한다)의 지정을 신청받은 담당 공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인만 해당한다)를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application for designation of the Central Women’s Economic Activity Support Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Central Support Center”) pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (applicable only to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제4조제4항에 따른 중앙여성경제활동지원센터 지정서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The designation certificate for the Central Women’s Economic Activity Support Center pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(중앙지원센터의 업무) 법 제16조제2항제8호에서 “공동부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 법 제17조제1항 각 호에 따른 사업과 관련한 우수사례 발굴 및 홍보를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Duties of the Central Support Center) The phrase “matters prescribed by joint ministerial decree” in Article 16, Paragraph 2, Item 8 of the Act refers to the discovery and promotion of best practices related to projects under each item of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 제6조(지역지원센터의 지정 신청 등) ① 영 제5조제2항에 따른 여성경제활동지원센터 지정신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Designation of Regional Support Center, etc.) ① The application form for designation of a Women’s Economic Activity Support Center pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제5조제2항에 따라 지역지원센터의 지정을 신청받은 담당 공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서(법인만 해당한다)를 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public official in charge who receives an application for the designation of a regional support center pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall verify the certificate of corporate registration (applicable only to corporations) through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제5조제4항에 따른 여성경제활동지원센터 지정서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The designation certificate for the Women’s Economic Activity Support Center pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(지역지원센터의 변경내용 등의 통지) ① 지역지원센터의 장은 영 제7조제4항제1호에 따라 지역지원센터의 법인ㆍ단체의 대표자, 지역지원센터의 장, 명칭 또는 소재지가 변경된 경우에는 별지 제3호서식의 여성경제활동지원센터 지정사항 변경통지서에 그 변경내용을 증명하는 서류를 첨부하여 성평등가족부장관이나 고용노동부장관에게 통지해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Notification of Changes, etc., to Regional Support Centers) ① In accordance with Article 7, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, if the representative of the corporation or organization of a Regional Support Center, the head of the Regional Support Center, or the name or address is changed, the head of a Regional Support Center shall notify the Minister of Gender Equality and Family or the Minister of Employment and Labor by attaching documents proving the details of the change to the Notice of Change in Designated Matters of Women's Economic Activity Support Center (Form No. 3). <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 지역지원센터의 장은 영 제7조제4항제2호에 따라 지역지원센터를 폐지하거나 그 운영을 정지하려는 경우에는 별지 제4호서식의 여성경제활동지원센터 폐지ㆍ운영정지 통지서를 성평등가족부장관이나 고용노동부장관에게 통지해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where the head of a regional support center intends to abolish a regional support center or suspend its operation pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall notify the Minister of Gender Equality and Family or the Minister of Employment and Labor using the Notice of Abolition or Suspension of Operation of Women's Economic Activity Support Center in the form of Annex 4. < Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <고용노동부령 제352호, 여성가족부령 제175호, 2022. 6. 8.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Employment and Labor Decree No. 352, Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Decree No. 175, June 8, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2022년 6월 8일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 8, 2022.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 고용노동부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules on the Organization of the Ministry of Employment and Labor and its Affiliated Agencies is amended as follows:

rows.source_ko: 제6조의2제8항제6호 중 “경력단절여성 경제활동 촉진 관련 법령”을 “여성의 경제활동 촉진과 경력단절 예방 관련 법령”으로 하고, 같은 항 제7호 중 “경력단절여성지원센터”를 “여성경제활동지원센터”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 6-2, Paragraph 8, Subparagraph 6, “laws and regulations related to the promotion of economic activities of women with interrupted careers” shall be changed to “laws and regulations related to the promotion of women’s economic activities and the prevention of career interruption,” and in Subparagraph 7 of the same paragraph, “career interruption support center for women” shall be changed to “women’s economic activity support center.”

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <성평등가족부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (성평등가족부 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Gender Equality and Family Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 부터 제5조까지 생략
rows.text_en: Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제6조(다른 법령의 개정) ①부터 ⑭까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑭ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑮ 여성의 경제활동 촉진과 경력단절 예방법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 15. The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Promotion of Women's Economic Activities and Prevention of Career Interruption are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 각 호 외의 부분 및 별지 제1호서식의 처리절차란 중 “여성가족부”를 각각 “성평등가족부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2 and in the processing procedure section of Form No. 1 of the Appendix, “Ministry of Gender Equality and Family” shall be changed to “Ministry of Gender Equality and Family”.

rows.source_ko: 제7조제1항ㆍ제2항 및 별지 제1호서식부터 별지 제4호서식까지 중 “여성가족부장관”을 각각 “성평등가족부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 7, Paragraphs 1 and 2, and Forms 1 through 4 of the Appendix, “Minister of Gender Equality and Family” shall be changed to “Minister of Gender Equality and Family”.

rows.source_ko: ⑯부터 ㉒까지 생략
rows.text_en: Omitted from 16 through 22

rows.text_en: [Attachment Form No. 1] Application for Designation (Central Women's Economic Activity Support Center, Women's Economic Activity Support Center)

rows.text_en: [Attachment Form No. 2] Designation Certificate (Central Women's Economic Activity Support Center, Women's Economic Activity Support Center)

rows.text_en: [Attachment Form No. 3] Notice of Change in Designation of Women’s Economic Activity Support Center (Representative, Head of Regional Support Center, Name, Location)

rows.text_en: [Attachment Form No. 4] Notice of Women's Economic Activity Support Center (Abolition, Suspension of Operation)
